jokes.j01: Bought a smartwatch. Now it reminds me every hour that I’m sitting. Thanks, I know.
jokes.j02: Password must contain a capital letter, a number and a symbol. I typed “Kitty1!”. It says: “Too weak.” I’m offended on the cat’s behalf.
jokes.j03: “Why are you late?” “I set the alarm for seven.” “And?” “It rang. I was surprised too.”
jokes.j04: I wanted to start a new life on Monday. Monday showed up without warning again.
jokes.j05: Deleted all my games to be more productive. Now I scroll the feed very productively.
jokes.j06: The courier texted: “Be there in 5 minutes.” That was yesterday. He must have his own minutes.
jokes.j07: Signed up for the gym. I’ve been walking past it for a month now — great cardio.
jokes.j08: A cat sleeps 16 hours a day, I sleep six. Who’s smarter is no longer a question.
jokes.j09: “How long to get ready?” “Five minutes.” “Honestly?” “Forty. But for five of them I’ll be saying ‘on my way’.”
jokes.j10: Weekend plan: rest. Reality: sorted the wardrobe, repotted the ficus and got more tired than all week.
jokes.j11: “Hello, is this customer support?” “Yes.” “Please support me. Just emotionally.”
jokes.j12: A friend texts: “You asleep?” I reply: “Yes.” Him: “Okay then.” Nice chat.
jokes.j13: Told myself: “Just one episode.” The sun disagreed — it was already rising.
jokes.j14: As a kid I thought adults knew what they were doing. Now I’m an adult and I know for sure: nope.
jokes.j15: Bought an organizer to tidy up. Now I’m looking for somewhere to put the organizer.
jokes.j16: “Why do cats always land on their feet?” “Because buttered toast took the other side.”
jokes.j17: Sat nav: “In 300 metres, turn right.” Me: “And in life?” It silently recalculated the route.
jokes.j18: Decided to go to bed early. Woke up at 2:40 to remember an awkward moment from seventh grade.
jokes.j19: My cat thinks I work for him. Judging by the feeding schedule, he’s right.
jokes.j20: “What do you give someone who has everything?” “A Sipsik. They definitely don’t have one.”
jokes.j21: Texted “ok”. Got “ok.” back, with a full stop. Now I can’t sleep, I’m analysing.
jokes.j22: Went out for bread. Bought a candle, a blanket and three kinds of biscuits. Forgot the bread, but it’s cozy.
jokes.j23: Turned on Do Not Disturb. My phone isn’t disturbed any more. Now I am.
jokes.j24: Told the smart speaker: “Play something for my mood.” It set an alarm for tomorrow.
jokes.j25: Decided to save money by not buying takeaway coffee. Bought a coffee machine. Been saving for three years now.

care.c02: You don’t have to be productive today. Just being is enough.
care.c03: A hard day can be lived in small steps. A sip of water is already a step.
care.c04: Your feelings matter, even if they’re uncomfortable right now.
care.c05: A mistake isn’t a failure. It’s just part of how we learn.
care.c06: You don’t have to handle everything alone. Asking for help is brave.
care.c07: Think of how many hard days are already behind you. This one will pass too.
care.c08: Take a deep breath in… and a slow breath out. I’m right here, purring 🐾
care.c09: Everyone has their own timing. You can’t be late in your own life.
care.c10: Small joys count too: warm tea, a blanket, this cat.
care.c11: If all you managed today was getting up — that’s a win too.
care.c12: You matter not for what you do, but simply because you are.
care.c13: You can be sad and still be okay.
care.c14: Be as kind to yourself as you are to your friends.
care.c15: Not everything needs solving today. Some things can wait until tomorrow.
care.c16: You can say “no” without explaining why.
care.c17: Rest is a task too. A very important one.
care.c18: Don’t compare your middle to someone else’s ending.
care.c19: Drink some water, eat something warm, go to bed early. I’ll keep an eye on you 🐾
care.c20: There are people who care about you. Even if it doesn’t feel that way right now.
care.c21: Today you can praise yourself a little. I’ll start: you’re a wonderful person.
care.c22: Whatever you’re feeling now will get lighter with time.
care.c23: I’m glad you’re here. It’s warm with you.
care.c24: You’re allowed a pause. The world can wait a couple of minutes.
care.c25: You can already do so much — even if you don’t notice it yourself.

facts.f01: Cats sleep 12–16 hours a day on average.
facts.f02: Cats can’t taste sweetness: their sweet-receptor gene doesn’t work.
facts.f03: A cat’s tongue is covered in tiny hooks — it combs its fur with them like a brush.
facts.f04: An octopus has three hearts and blue blood: it uses copper instead of iron.
facts.f05: Sunlight takes about 8 minutes 20 seconds to reach Earth.
facts.f06: Bananas are slightly radioactive because of potassium-40, but it’s completely safe.
facts.f07: An adult has 206 bones, a newborn about 300 — many fuse together later.
facts.f08: On Venus the Sun rises in the west: the planet spins “backwards”.
facts.f09: A day on Venus is longer than its year: 243 Earth days versus 225.
facts.f11: Sea otters sometimes hold paws while sleeping so the current doesn’t drift them apart.
facts.f12: In summer the Eiffel Tower grows about 15 cm taller: the metal expands in the heat.
facts.f13: A blue whale’s heart weighs about 180 kg.
facts.f14: On Mars sunsets are blue and days are orange-pink.
facts.f15: The shortest war in history — the Anglo-Zanzibar War of 1896 — lasted under an hour.
facts.f16: Botanically, a strawberry isn’t a berry, but a banana is.
facts.f17: Bees dance to show the others where they found nectar.
facts.f18: The brain is about 2% of body weight but uses about 20% of its energy.
facts.f20: Flamingos are pink because of pigments in their food — algae and tiny shrimp.
facts.f21: In space tears don’t run down — they gather in a ball by the eye.
facts.f22: Elephants recognize themselves in a mirror — very few animals can.
facts.f23: Sound travels about 4 times faster in water than in air.
facts.f24: A year on Neptune lasts about 165 Earth years.
facts.f25: Water can boil and freeze at the same time — at the so-called triple point.

sosTips.hug: Don’t ask “what happened”. Just hug and stay close for a couple of minutes.
sosTips.listen: Listen, don’t interrupt and don’t give advice unless asked. You can simply say: “I hear you.”
sosTips.space: Give some time and don’t take it personally. Say you’re there and they can come to you any time.
sosTips.calm: Take a pause of about 20 minutes. Then start with “I”: “I felt hurt when…”, not “you always…”. The goal is to understand each other, not to win.
sosTips.care: Tea, a blanket, something tasty or a few warm words. A little care means a lot right now.
